scope: Bounded selected photograph rights, identity, original/public-byte preservation and visual suitability. No rendered article/preview, responsive derivative, package or publication approval.

source.method: Independently opened actual Commons file page with web tool and read file-specific description, author/date/Own work, licence and SHA1; read retained page capture and candidate findings. Independently viewed same-series -3 sign image.
source.creator: SUDEEP PRAMANIK
source.rights: File-specific licence permits reuse with creator/source/licence and changes retained; derivative copies must retain applicable share-alike terms. Not inferred from site footer.

actual_media.method: Independent actual Sharp decode and cryptographic measurements; original and public JPEG byte-identical, full frame. Both files individually opened with view_image.

visual_assessment.result: Suitable for article and preview subject to actual crop checks.
visual_assessment.observed: Clear yellow shrine, red roof edge and small tower, pale steps and lattice entrance amid tall trees and woodland. Shrine is recognisable with good texture and useful setting. Bright foliage highlights and deep doorway shade are source conditions, not a new processing defect.
visual_assessment.quality_limit: 1280x960 original is adequate for intended normal article/card displays; no claim of modern high-resolution documentary survey. Actual smaller variants and crop/layout still require inspection.
visual_assessment.identity: Creator-labelled Guptaganga series plus independently visible Odisha Tourism GONASIKA (GUPTAGANGA) sign supports destination identification. Same-series sign is corroboration within one photographer series, not independent geolocation.
visual_assessment.incidental_person: Visitor remains incidental in original; no name, role, age inference or story adopted.

copy_review.caption: Guptaganga shrine at Gonasika, photographed in March 2018.
copy_review.alt: A yellow shrine with red roof trim and white steps among tall trees at Guptaganga.
copy_review.preview_credit: Guptaganga at Gonasika: SUDEEP PRAMANIK, CC BY-SA 4.0; previews may be cropped.
copy_review.changes: Original photograph; responsive copies are resized and previews may be cropped.
copy_review.assessment: Narrow caption correctly identifies Guptaganga shrine and creator-supplied historical month/year. Alt matches visible content. Preview credit includes creator/licence and crop qualification; changes distinguishes unchanged original from responsive resizing. No dated Brahmeswar building identification, source-water visibility, present access/condition, safety, architecture chronology or visitor identity inferred.
